_comment: The 5 survey Data Collection fields. Written via agents_update body.platform_settings.data_collection. NOTE: that write is a FULL REPLACE, not a merge — send the agent's complete field set or the omitted ones are deleted.

survey_offered.description: True only if the agent actually asked the caller whether they had twenty seconds for two quick questions. False if the agent never raised the survey at all.

survey_consent.description: How the caller responded to the survey offer. One of: accepted (agreed to answer), declined (said no), not_offered (the agent never asked).

offer_context.description: Where in the call the survey was offered. One of: in_call (near the end of a normal call, before goodbye), pre_transfer (just before the agent connected them to a specialist), not_offered (the agent never asked).

satisfaction.description: The caller's answer to "Quick one to five, how was that for you?" — record what they actually said, in their own words ("five", "4 out of 5", "pretty good"). Leave empty if the question was not asked or not answered. Do NOT infer a rating from the caller's tone or from how the call went.

prefer_agent.description: The caller's answer to whether, next time, they would rather handle a question like this with the agent or hold for a person even if it took longer. Record their own words ("with you", "I'd wait for a person", "either is fine"). Leave empty if the question was not asked or not answered. Do NOT infer this from anything else in the call.
